text: おまえ　おれの　こと　いなかもん　とか　おもっただろ

patterns.name: 〜のこと
patterns.explanation: のこと after a person means 'things about' that person; it is the usual way to say who you think or feel something about. おれの　こと = 'about me'.

patterns.name: 〜とか
patterns.span: いなかもん　とか　おもった
patterns.explanation: とか before a thinking or saying verb quotes the thought loosely, like 'or something like that'. いなかもん　とか　おもった = 'thought I was a bumpkin or something'.

patterns.name: 〜だろう
patterns.explanation: だろう at the end pushes the listener to agree; the short だろ is rough male speech. おもっただろ = 'you thought so, didn't you'.
